visibleText.title: ANYTHING USEFUL?
bodyLines: If you Explored a new Room, draw 1 Item for
each [UNRESOLVED ICON: solid white chamfered-corner polygon] in that Room.

unresolvedIconOccurrences.cardLocation: Center of the second body line, between “each” and “in that Room.”
unresolvedIconOccurrences.visibleDiscriminator: The reference has a green chamfered field containing a distinct white plus, whereas the card glyph is uniformly white and has no visible plus.

unresolvedIconOccurrences.cardLocation: Center of the second body line, between “each” and “in that Room.”
unresolvedIconOccurrences.visibleDiscriminator: The reference has a red chamfered field with three separate white ammunition-like marks; none of those internal marks appears on the card glyph.

unresolvedIconOccurrences.cardLocation: Center of the second body line, between “each” and “in that Room.”
unresolvedIconOccurrences.visibleDiscriminator: The reference has a yellow chamfered field containing a diagonal white wrench-like mark, while the card glyph has no internal mark.

unresolvedIconOccurrences.cardLocation: Upper-right corner above the title plaque
unresolvedIconOccurrences.closestAlternative: A crossed-out elongated badge or equipment-shaped emblem.
unresolvedIconOccurrences.visibleDiscriminator: The reference uses a red circular prohibition ring with a single diagonal slash over a compact internal figure, whereas the card uses two full diagonals forming an X over an elongated stepped underform.

decisionReasons: All material words and punctuation are directly readable, and the contact sheet introduces no text correction.
No authorized item reference matches both the body glyph’s outer presentation and internal marks.
The upper-right graphic visibly differs from the authorized not-in-combat reference in both prohibition geometry and underlying silhouette.
Emitting an item or not-in-combat semantic token would therefore exceed the authorized pixel evidence.
The worker is staging-only; exact generated-cell/paired-side and supervisor promotion gates remain external.

visibleText.title: DEMOLITION
visibleText.body:
Remove 1 Door.
OR
Place a [malfunction] in your Room.

verifiedIconOccurrences.cardLocation: Lower instruction line, between “Place a” and “in your Room.”
verifiedIconOccurrences.closestAlternative: Generic gear/settings icon or circular saw-like ring.
verifiedIconOccurrences.visibleDiscriminator: The card glyph and authorized crop share eight broad squared teeth, the same rounded annular body, and a similarly proportioned circular central void; a saw or sunburst would instead have narrow pointed rays.

decisionReasons: The authorized reference panel visibly identifies its glossary crop as “malfunction.”
The card glyph matches the reference in outer silhouette, eight-tooth arrangement, annular body, and central opening.
The title, both instructions, divider, punctuation, and footer are visibly readable, and the blind transcription requires no text correction.
The worker is staging-only; exact generated-cell/paired-side and supervisor promotion gates remain external.

verifiedIconOccurrences.visibleDiscriminator: Both card and reference have the same nested dark frame, pale rounded-rectangle field, and centered black capital A; it is not merely an unboxed printed letter.

verifiedIconOccurrences.cardLocation: First instruction line, immediately after “Discard a”
verifiedIconOccurrences.closestAlternative: A generic gear or cog pictogram
verifiedIconOccurrences.visibleDiscriminator: The card glyph and reference share the same blunt eight-tooth perimeter, pale annular body, and dark round center rather than a solid sunburst or plain circle.

unresolvedIconOccurrences.cardLocation: Upper-right corner of the illustrated area
unresolvedIconOccurrences.referenceLabel: No authorized glossary crop supplied for this glyph
unresolvedIconOccurrences.closestAlternative: A crossed-out winged-bar or bidirectional-arrow-like pictogram
unresolvedIconOccurrences.visibleDiscriminator: Its dominant red diagonal X and white lateral projections visibly differ from both the boxed-A silhouette and the toothed circular malfunction glyph.

decisionReasons: The two inline instruction glyphs visibly match the authorized action-card and malfunction glossary crops in both outer shape and internal marks.
The contact sheet corrects the first instruction’s inter-clause punctuation from a period to a comma.
A separate upper-right emblem has no authorized reference and cannot safely receive a semantic token.
No official-page heading or topic is visible from which to verify official-page identity.

lowerPanel.instruction:
If you are Heavily Injured, you die.
Otherwise, get a Serious Wound
on each empty Serious Wound
slot to the right
of your Health marker.
Then, get 1 Serious Wound more.

The inline glyph has a matching reference copy but no authorized visible semantic label; promoting it to a named token would require inference from game semantics.
